answer.overall: The contract meets the policy except that it is missing public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The subscription fee of £18,000 a year is payable annually in advance; payment is due within 30 days of invoice.
findings.note: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice, as the policy asks.

findings.contract_says: Tidewell's total liability in any subscription period is limited to the fees paid in that period.
findings.note: The limit is the fees paid in a subscription period of 12 months, which is the contract's annual value of £18,000.
The contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The subscription renews automatically for a further 12 months at the end of each subscription period; to stop it renewing, either party must give written notice at least 60 days before the renewal date.
findings.note: It renews automatically, and the customer can stop it with 60 days' notice, within the policy's three months.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
